messages:
alex_support: FYI customer acme-corp (tenant: acme) opened a ticket — console dashboard panels are blank and show a spinning loader then a 500 toast. They say this started ~6h ago after a large import.

alex_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Console -> Dashboards -> 'Acme Operations'
2) Time range: Last 7 days
3) Click refresh -> panels spin then fail with 500 / 'Error retrieving data'

alex_support: I can reproduce in our staging account too. Small curl shows the analytics endpoint is returning 502/504 intermittently:
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/query" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE tenant_id=\"acme\"","from":"2026-03-16T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-03-17T00:00:00Z"}'
```

system-bot: monitoring-alert: analytics-api error-rate spike detected (5xx) - incident INC-2026-1849 created

maria_oncall: Taking this. Oncall checking infra and ingestion queues now.

maria_oncall: Prometheus shows analytics-api latency jump ~05:10 UTC, 95p latency from 120ms -> 1.8s and error-rate to 12%.

maria_oncall: Checked ClickHouse ingestion lag: consumer lag on topic "events-ingest" is high (lag ~1.2M msgs). Kafka cluster shows CPU spikes.

jenna_sre: Noted. Any deploys around that time? deploy-bot: "deploy redwood/analytics-api @ 2026-03-16T05:08Z by ci/cd"

dan_eng-infra: I pulled analytics-api logs for the 05:05-05:20 window — see repeated "Read timed out connecting to clickhouse" and kv-cache eviction warnings.

dan_eng-infra: Sample log:
```
2026-03-16T05:12:14Z ERROR analytics-api request_id=req_0a1b2c message="upstream clickhouse timeout" backend=clickhouse dur_ms=10005
```

alex_support: Customer also attached screenshots and a short clip. Sending links to ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/ACME-1024 (internal only).

jenna_sre: Tentative hypothesis: backpressure from a large bulk import caused consumer lag -> clickhouse slow -> analytics-api requests time out and surface as 5xx to console.

jenna_sre: Immediate mitigations:
- Throttle or pause the bulk import if possible (ask customer)
- Temporarily scale up clickhouse replicas / increase analytics-api request timeout and circuit-breaker thresholds
- Enable a short-term cache for the dashboard queries (prefix cache)

maria_oncall: I've scaled the analytics-api deployment + added 2 clickhouse cpu nodes. Watching metrics.

dan_eng-infra: Also bumped consumer parallelism for the events-ingest consumer to reduce lag.

maria_oncall: Error rate dropped to 1.2% and dashboard panels started returning data at ~05:34 UTC. I'll keep this open until we confirm with customer.

alex_support: Customer confirmed panels are back and graphs populate. They will postpone their bulk import and we've asked for better rate-limits for large imports.

alex_support: Follow-ups: create a runbook item for bulk-import detection, add automatic ingestion-surge alerting, and add a graceful fallback in console UI for transient analytics errors.

dan_eng-infra: Filed infra ticket INFRA-739 to add ingestion backpressure alarms and recommended ClickHouse autoscale knobs.

alex_support: Thanks all :thumbsup:
